'''Kal''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], who lived on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] and was a teenager during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. After there were some riots in the city of [[Gadrin]], Kal and the [[Tarasin]] [[Dannik]], were sent by the [[Cularin Militia]] to tail the [[Heroes of Cularin]].
